Rodrigo Gomez-Fell was part of a group of experts who facilitated a discussion on investing
in the next generation of Antarctic expertise at Christchurch's Antarctic Season Opening,
looking ahead to the Fifth International Polar Year (2032–33). He also presented a poster on
his research. The event is listed on the [Teaching](../teaching.qmd#lectures) page.
